messages:
anna-ml: kicking off thread for this week's model candidate ranking. shortlist: atlas-13b-qlora, orca-mini-34b, ceres-30b-int8. please post quick perf/quality notes and a suggested score 0-100 by EOD. thanks

devin-infra: infra note — atlas runs well on our A100 pool, batching fine. orca-mini memory-friendly. ceres-30b int8 had 8-12% lower throughput on p3 due to kernel fallback. :thinking:

marco-research: eval highlights: atlas-13b best pass@1 on codebench (72%), orca-mini weaker on reasoning tasks but very fast. ceres-30b int8 shows slight hallucination uptick on factual QA. attaching quick numbers:
```
atlas-13b: latency 120ms/token, perf score 85
orca-mini-34b: latency 55ms/token, perf score 68
ceres-30b-int8: latency 95ms/token, perf score 76 (but quality drop on QA)
```

sara-pm: product priority: low-latency assistants are high priority this quarter, so batch-weight to latency x1.5 when scoring. also need to consider Dedicated customers (security/quantization) — ceres int8 attractive if we can mitigate QA drop.

anna-ml: proposing scoring rubric update: final_score = 0.5 * quality + 0.4 * latency_score + 0.1 * infra_risk. quick pseudo:
```
quality:0-100 (eval suite)
latency_score = max(0, 100 - (latency_ms_per_token - 50))
infra_risk: 0-100 (ops input)
```
vote? :ballot_box_with_ballot:

devin-infra: infra_risk: atlas 20, orca-mini 10, ceres-int8 35. ceres needs kernel work for T4s.

marco-research: I'm +1 on atlas and orca-mini for canary. ceres needs a focused quantization experiment (re-run with qdrop and calibration). I'd put ceres on hold until we try that. :mag:

anna-ml: timeline suggestion — canary atlas this week (small traffic), orca-mini as fast-path experiment, ceres quantization lab next sprint. I'll add tasks to the intake board and update scores by EOD.

eval-bot: automated evals updated: atlas-13b -> 84.6 quality, orca-mini-34b -> 67.9, ceres-30b-int8 -> 74.1. full csv in /s3/redwood-evals/1782345600_candidates.csv

sara-pm: thanks all — sync at 3pm if anyone wants to dispute weighting. otherwise I'll accept atlas + orca-mini for this week's rollout plan. :white_check_mark:
